title: Develop a Single Page Application using React Router, Hooks and Component Lifecycle Behaviour
requirements: React Router (BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, NavLink, Link)
React Hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext, useMemo, useParams, useNavigate)
Component lifecycle behaviour (mount, update, cleanup, param change)
implemented: React Router v6 creates a Single Page Application with declarative BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, NavLink, Link, and Outlet layout.
Dynamic routing with useParams() extracts book ID parameters and useEffect() manages async lifecycle data fetching and title synchronization.
Custom React Hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext, useMemo, useNavigate, useLocation) control search, filtering, auth sessions, and protected route guarding.
